ingestion/ssrf-matrix.spec.ts: APIRequestContext checks the Node endpoint; no browser page is used.
library/stats-strip.spec.ts: Seeded reading-time totals, conditional copy, DOM order, and deletion totals; no layout or focus assertions.
library/progress-recent.spec.ts: Seeded progress ratios, membership, ordering, and React node identity; geometry and restoration are covered separately.
review-panel/tri-state.spec.ts: Seeded anchor-status badges, filtering, and disabled controls; selection, focus, and navigation are covered separately.
library/browse-open.spec.ts: Library listing rows, Sample/Pasted badge labels, and route navigation over seeded and ingested state; the one accessibility check (aria-labelledby wiring on the Open link) is static markup identical in every engine, and no layout, selection, focus, zoom, or announcement assertions exist.
